behavior_constraints: `build`, `lock`, and `check` commands accept an optional `--targets <name1>,<name2>,...` flag restricting operation to named targets plus transitive dependencies
When `--targets` references an unknown target, exit code 1 and stderr `error: unknown target: '<name>'`
Build set under `--targets` = named targets + all transitive deps, built in topological order
build JSON `targets` array contains only built targets when `--targets` is used
lock lockfile `targets` map contains only built targets when `--targets` is used

check under `--targets` ignores lockfile targets not in build set; `all_match` reflects only checked targets; `targets` array contains only checked targets; `impacted_by` still reflects transitive deps within build set
`--targets` and `--profile` may be combined in any order
New `buildvault status <manifest_path>` command prints one JSON line with `targets` array (topological order), `total_cached`, `total_uncached`, `store_size_bytes`
status target entry has fields: name, fingerprint, cached, stale_entries
entities.summary: This round adds selective `--targets` builds to build/lock/check, a new `status` cache-state command, and per-target `constraints` (require_profiles/incompatible_profiles) enforced by all commands.

instruction_head:
This round adds selective builds, a cache status command, and target-level build constraints.

## Extension: Selective Builds

The `build`, `lock`, and `check` commands now accept an optional `--targets <name1>,<name2>,...` flag that restricts the operation to only the named targets and their transitive dependencies.

When `--targets` is specified:
